name: MNLP_M3_allenai_reward_bench
description: A benchmark suite for evaluating reward-modeling / preference alignment on datasets derived from AllenAI resources. It measures how well learned reward or preference models align with reference judgments across multiple NLP tasks and instances. Typical uses include ranking, preference prediction, and reward consistency evaluation.
reputation: An experimental benchmark for reward-model evaluation with limited but growing use among researchers working on alignment and RLHF.
